objective: Expose binary business-document reality to the model without building service-specific semantics.

openclaw.spreadsheet: No bundled spreadsheet-specific skill was present in the inspected local installation; terminal remains the general route.

anthropic_skills.lesson: A successful command exit is not spreadsheet correctness.

legacy_t5.observed: Document extensions occurred in file-location fixtures and plans, but no XLSX/PDF parser, generator, formula recalculation, or re-open verification implementation was found.

githubCandidates.name: clawpdf
githubCandidates.reason: OpenClaw-proven zero-runtime-dependency PDFium WASM text extraction and rendering boundary; compatible with Node 20+.

githubCandidates.name: @office-kit/xlsx
githubCandidates.reason: Node 22+ pure TypeScript OOXML read/write, three direct runtime dependencies, decompression guards, formula cache and advanced-part passthrough. Pre-1.0 status remains explicit.

githubCandidates.name: exceljs
githubCandidates.reason: Trial install added 98 packages, several deprecated transitive packages, and an indirect moderate advisory requiring a forced uuid override.

githubCandidates.name: Docling
githubCandidates.reason: Powerful unified document representation and table/OCR pipelines, but substantially heavier than the first machine-readable XLSX/PDF requirement.

githubCandidates.name: pdfplumber_or_PyMuPDF
githubCandidates.reason: Strong coordinate/table extraction, but the product currently has no managed Python runtime and clawpdf closes the first text-PDF boundary.

t5Contracts: source path, hash, sheet/cell or page provenance
merged, hidden, formula, cached-result and number-format facts stay distinct
unknown or conflicting business meaning is not inferred
new output by default; no silent overwrite
formula requires an independently supplied cached result
output is re-opened and reconciled with sources
